info.title: Cyient DLM Engineering Change Note API
info.description:
Backend of the Cyient DLM workflow applications. Every endpoint needs sign-in unless it says otherwise.

**Sign-in (Development):** put a login in the `X-Dev-User` header, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`, using the authentication box on this page. With no header the default user is used. `X-Dev-Groups` adds AD groups.

**Responses** use one envelope: `success`, `data`, `message`, `errors` (each with `code`, `message` and,
for a field, `field`), `meta` (paging: `page`, `pageSize`, `totalCount`, `totalPages`), `traceId` (quote it
when reporting a problem), `timestamp` and `durationMs`. Files (downloads, Excel, PDF) are sent as they are.

**Errors:** 400/422 validation (`errors[].field` names the field), 401 not signed in, 403 not allowed or not
set up (`AUTH_NOT_REGISTERED`), 404 not found, 409 conflict, such as `PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT` when someone
else saved first, 429 too many calls.

**Changes:** send back the `version` from the last read; a stale one gets 409. New drafts take an
`Idempotency-Key` header, so a repeated click returns the same draft. Dates are `yyyy-MM-dd` in India
time; times are UTC. Enums travel as names, such as `ImsReview`.

post.description:
Uploads a document to the initiator's note as multipart/form-data: field "file", and "kind": CustomerDocument (customer ECN or TCN, several files), EcrApproval (when ECR Approval From Customer is Yes), SapEcn (the one PDF, SAP ECN only) while the note is a draft, or CftAction with "cftActionId" for an NPI Engineer tab action in CFT Review. The same file name again, or a "fileKey", adds a new version; earlier versions are kept.

**Permission:** `ecn.note.create` (Raise an ECN or TCN, and add a customer); by default the Requester role.

**Limit:** 60 calls a minute per user; more get `429 PLATFORM_RATE_LIMITED`.

version.description: The note's `version` from the last read.

AttendanceInput.description: Whether each named member attended the CFT meeting of a TCN.

CftActionDetails.description: One predefined action as the function tab shows it.

targetDate.description: Required when the action is Closed (RULE-07).

closedDate.description: Required when the action is Closed (RULE-07).

fromRevision.description: NPI Engineer tab only. At most 50 characters.

toRevision.description: NPI Engineer tab only. At most 50 characters.

dispositionStatus.description: For the ECN Tracker. At most 200 characters.

itemAffected.description: For the ECN Tracker. At most 500 characters.

rawMaterial.description: For the ECN Tracker. At most 500 characters.

version.description: The action's `version` from the last read.

CftActionInput.description: One predefined action on a function tab, as the member updates it.

actionText.description: The action as the QMS template words it. Required, at most 500 characters.

version.description: Required when editing: the `version` from the last read.

code.description: A short code, unique. Required, at most 50 characters.

name.description: As shown on the CFT Team tab. Required, at most 100 characters.

version.description: Required when editing: the `version` from the last read.

functionId.description: The `functionId` from `GET /api/v1/cft-functions`. The NPI Engineer row is always the initiator and is not sent.

userId.description: An `id` from the people picker; empty when the function is Not Applicable.

notApplicable.description: True when the function is not needed for this change; then no person is sent.

CftMemberInput.description: One function on the CFT Team tab: a person, or Not Applicable.

version.description: The note's `version` from the last read.

CftTeamInput.description: The whole CFT Team tab. Functions not sent are left without a person (the meeting notification waits for them).

tabEnabled.description: Whether the function's tab is in use: a person was named and the note was published to the CFT.

CftTeamRow.description: One function on the CFT Team tab with its tab: who was named (or Not Applicable), the TCN attendance, and once published to the CFT its predefined actions. Only functions with a named person get a tab (RULE-06).

name.description: The customer's name; kept in capitals, as today. Required, at most 200 characters.
Required, at most 200 characters; kept in capitals.

productDescription.description: Product Description (Card Type). Required, at most 500 characters.

customerEcnNumber.description: ECN only: from the customer's change document, or NA when there is none. Required, at most 100 characters.

customerEcnDate.description: ECN only: the date of the customer's change document; empty when there is none.

ecrApprovalFromCustomer.description: Required. When true, the ECR approval must be attached before the meeting notification (RULE-02).

productRevisionNumber.description: The current product revision. Required, at most 50 characters.

sapEcnNumber.description: SAP ECN only (RULE-01): the 12-digit 5-series number from SAP, which becomes the ECN No. Required for SAP, not allowed otherwise.

sapEcnDate.description: SAP ECN only: required for SAP, not allowed otherwise; today or earlier (India time).

category1Id.description: The `id` of an EcnCategory1 item (`GET /api/v1/masters/EcnCategory1`). Required.

category2Id.description: The `id` of an EcnCategory2 item (`GET /api/v1/masters/EcnCategory2`). Required.

summary.description: Summary of the change. Required, at most 4000 characters.

comments.description: At most 4000 characters. Optional on an ECN; required on a TCN, where every field is (NA when not available).

reviewerUserId.description: An `id` from the people picker (`GET /api/v1/directory/users`). Required; not the initiator.

approverUserId.description: An `id` from the people picker. Required; not the initiator. May be the Reviewer.

effectiveSerialNumber.description: TCN only: the serial numbers the change applies to. Required on a TCN, at most 1000 characters.

customerTcnNumber.description: TCN only: the customer TCN number, or NA. Required on a TCN, at most 100 characters.

reasonForChange.description: TCN only. Required on a TCN, at most 4000 characters.

version.description: Required when editing: the version returned by the last read.

DraftDetails.description: The front page (New ECN or New TCN tab), as sent when creating or editing a draft.

EmailDetails.description: An email with what caused it: who acted, and the workflow action (design 9.4).

HistoryEntry.description: One line of a note's history. Workflow lines have Stage, Action and Comment; data lines have Item, Action (Insert, Update, Delete, Download, Pdf) and, for updates, Field with its old and new value.

userId.description: The user to give the role to: an `id` from the users list or the people picker.

adGroup.description: An Active Directory group as DOMAIN\Group; its members get the role.

HolderInput.description: Either a user or an AD group (DOMAIN\Group), not both.

actionTaken.description: What was done. Required, at most 2000 characters.

responsible.description: Who did it. At most 200 characters.

version.description: Required when editing: the version returned by the last read.

ImmediateActionInput.description: One action closed on the spot at the CFT meeting. The exact fields are still to confirm (O6).

timeZone.description: The zone DailyAt is in: the job's own, or the business time zone.

nextRun.description: When the Notification Service runs it next; null when the job is switched off.

LogEntry.description: One Log entry. Stage is the code (CftReview, Release); StageName is how users know it (CFT Review).

code.description: A short code, for example HYD. Required, at most 50 characters.

name.description: The name shown in drop-downs. Required, at most 200 characters.

isActive.description: False stops the item being offered; items are never deleted.

version.description: Needed when changing an item; ignored when creating one.

type.description: The list's key, used in the URLs: Location, Department or ReasonCategory.

name.description: The list's display name, for screens only.

pendingCount.description: Tasks waiting for the user in this application (the Pending Actions badge); null where the application has none.

sapEcnNumber.description: For a SAP ECN, the SAP ECN number, which is also its ECN No.

missingForMeetingNotification.description: While a draft: what is still missing before Send Meeting Notification is enabled (RULE-05), for example a CFT function without a person or Not Applicable. Empty when it can be sent.

NoteListItem.description: One row of the In Progress, Closed and Search grids: the current tool's columns (Screen 1). For a TCN, CustomerEcnNumber holds the customer TCN number.

NumberingCheckResult.description:
One counter compared with the numbers its application has actually given out. Numbers are gap-free by design
(design 5.7), so any missing or repeated number, or a counter below a used number, needs looking at.

partNumber.description: FG code or product part number. Required, at most 100 characters.

materialDetails.description: Material details from the SAP ECN PDF. At most 1000 characters.

version.description: Required when editing: the version returned by the last read.

PartInput.description: One row of the ECN Parts tab, as sent when adding or editing it. The exact fields are still to confirm (O6).

PersonResult.description: One result of the people picker.

targetDate.description: ECN Target Date: the date by which the CFT must close their actions. Required; today or later (India time).

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

ReportItem.description: One open ECN on the Report tab: enough to follow up with the CFT.

ReportPending.description: A function with actions still open on the ECN, and who holds it.

RoleHolder.description: One holder of a role: a user, or an AD group whose members hold it.

isActive.description: False switches the role off: its holders lose its permissions.

permissions.description: The full list of permission codes (`GET /api/v1/admin/permissions`); it replaces the current list.

version.description: Needed when changing a role; ignored when creating one.

RoleInput.description: A role's name, description, state and the full list of its permission codes.

UserRoleItem.description: A role the user holds directly; int UserRoleItem.HolderId is used to remove it.

isActive.description: False switches the user off, true switches them on again.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

commit.description: The git commit the build came from, so support can tell exactly which build is running.

version.description: The `version` from the last read; a stale one gets `409 PLATFORM_VERSION_CONFLICT`.

WorkflowActionInput.description: A workflow action: an optional comment and the version from the last read.

DevUser.description: Development sign-in: the login to act as, for example `CYIENTDLM\ims`. Left empty, calls are made as the default user.
DevUser.name: X-Dev-User

tags.name: Me
tags.description: The signed-in user, with the roles and permission codes the front end uses to show or hide actions.

tags.name: Master lists
tags.description: Master lists. Anyone signed in reads the active items (for drop-downs); administrators with master.manage see inactive ones too, add items and change them.

tags.name: People picker
tags.description: The people picker, for choosing approvers (design 6.7). Any signed-in user; only active people are found.

tags.name: System
tags.description: Which build of the application this server runs. Any signed-in user.

tags.name: ECN lists
tags.description: The lists kept in the tool: customers (any user adds one by name; ECN admins rename or switch them off) and the CFT functions with their predefined actions (master-list administrators). Category 1 and 2 are platform master lists: `GET /api/v1/masters/EcnCategory1` and `EcnCategory2`.

tags.name: Notes: documents
tags.description: The documents of a note (design 6.7): upload a file or a new version, list them, download one.

tags.name: Notes: drafts and tabs
tags.description: ECNs and TCNs: the front page, the CFT Team tab, ECN Parts and Immediate Actions (design 6.7).

tags.name: Notes: lists and reports
tags.description: The In Progress, Closed and Search lists, their Excel export, the ECN Tracker, the Report tab and the PDF of a note (design 6.7). Files are the one response not wrapped in the envelope; an error before the file starts still is.

tags.name: Notes: workflow
tags.description: The ECN and TCN workflow (design 6.7): meeting notification, publish to the CFT, the CFT actions, Reviewer, Approver and release, with Pending Actions and the Log. Who may act at each step is checked by the workflow itself: the initiator, the member named for a function, or the Reviewer or Approver picked on the note.

tags.name: Admin: ECN
tags.description: ECN administration (design 6.8): open tasks (task.manage), cancelling a note with a reason (request.admin), and a note's emails, audit and full history.

tags.name: Admin: audit, emails and logs
tags.description: The audit trail (audit.view), the email log with retry and resend (email.manage), and the technical log (log.view). Lists are newest first and paged.

tags.name: Admin: jobs
tags.description: The daily jobs (job.run): when each runs next in the Notification Service, and "run now". A job run now runs in this API and the call returns when it has finished.

tags.name: Admin: numbering
tags.description: Request-number counters and the numbering check (sequence.manage). Read-only: counters are never set by hand.

tags.name: Admin: roles
tags.description: Roles and their permissions (role.manage), and who holds them (user.manage). Holders are users or AD groups. A change that would leave nobody able to manage roles and users is refused.

tags.name: Admin: users
tags.description: People synced from Active Directory: search them, see their roles, switch them off or on in this application.
